svg.title: White Relief with Black III
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours. Overlapping black rectangle and rotated white panel follow the photograph. Thin neutral line is a relief-edge guide, not grey paint. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.glenstone.org/artworks/white-relief-with-black-iii; inspected2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation, not a facsimile.
